title: GAFC Safe Storage Wisdom
body:
💯🛡️ Alright, GAFC Fam, let's keep it 💯 on what really matters: protecting our own! 🛡️ Gloxsie 21 just schooled Bobo Licious on why 'out of sight' ain't always 'out of reach' for curious little hands. Bobo almost had a moment thinking his gun under the mattress was 'safe enough' from his nieces! 😂

Nah, fam. Legal gun ownership means *responsible* gun ownership. That firearm is there to protect, not accidentally harm. Lock it up, store ammo separate, know your tools. As our partners at Church of Legacy preach, stewardship means safeguarding all our blessings. This ain't just about rules; it's about building a safer legacy for our community.

What's YOUR best tip for securing firearms at home, especially with youth around? Share the wisdom! 👇

#GAFC #GunSafetyIsLove #CommunityProtection #SecureOurKids
